descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S02 The same walk in Nursing Home: manual add, duplicate kept, chart opened, visit completed, task completed and deleted

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Adding a patient by scan and by manual entry is logged, each add tagged by method (scan vs manual), in Hospital and in Nursing Home (UAT OAT-06 Test 1; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 1; TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 Analytics)
  • U3 A duplicate-detection prompt logs that it was shown, and logs whether the physician accepted or rejected it (manual add and scan, both contexts) (UAT OAT-06 Test 3; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 1; TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 AC 5)
  • U6 Completing an encounter fires both timestamps (Pre-Round summary opened, note marked complete), and they aggregate per physician per day (UAT OAT-06 Test 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 4)
  • U8 Completing a task and deleting a task are logged as separate events; task reminders are tracked live (completed vs deleted logged separately) (UAT OAT-06 Test 7; UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 1; UAT TC-24; TFA-94514 AC 2)
  • U15 Usage analytics rows carry no patient content (no name, MRN, room, diagnosis, task text or note text), so rows that outlive a deleted patient do not break the 36 h retention claim or TC-24's hard del … (UAT 3.6; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Fresh physician switched to Nursing Home; the seeded resident has a finished visit note and two open tasks; T0 recorded

When Add resident 'QA Resident OAT06 Manual'; add the same name again (no MRN, no date of birth) and answer Cancel; open {snfResident}'s chart on Pre-Round; on Post-Round complete task 1 (the first button in its row) and delete task 2 (the trash icon at the end of its row), then tap Mark Visit Complete

Then The same rows as S01 with careSetting nursing_home: patient_added manual x1, duplicate shown + accepted (addMethod manual), pre_round_summary_opened x1, note_marked_complete x1 (minutes numeric), task_completed x1, task_deleted x1; today's nursing_home rollup +1 on each counter; the hospital rollup row is unchanged; no patient content in any row. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.3 (both modes) applied to OAT-06 Test 1, 3, 5, 7. Same post-run reads as S01 with nursing_home. Checkpoints only show each step happened on screen (cp2 the list, cp3 the completed state)

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
